name: branding-lime-and-forest-green-eco-app-brand-board
title: Lime and Forest Green Eco Brand Board
whatItIs: A bento board with a lime-edged phone showing an energy dashboard, a hand holding a lime asterisk app icon, colour cards with RGB and hex, a dark wordmark tile, a tilted billboard on a tower, a leaf photo with the logo, a download banner with lime icon tiles and an Instagram story.
whatItMeans: Lime and forest green feel natural and energetic, and the bold asterisk mark works at every scale.
techniques: Asterisk mark on a lime rounded square
Dark green wordmark tile as the anchor
Angled billboard with a lime speech-shape
Photography of leaves and people in the brand tones
Story format with bold headline on lime
bestFor: Apps with a bold single-symbol logo

vocabulary.definition: A rounded square holding the brand mark.
A swatch listing RGB and hex values.
A pointed shape framing text like a speech bubble.
